scripts.build:native: dotnet publish apps\windows-lockdown\Lockedscreen.Security.Service\Lockedscreen.Security.Service.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -o apps\windows-lockdown\publish\service && dotnet publish apps\windows-lockdown\Lockedscreen.Security.Client\Lockedscreen.Security.Client.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -o apps\windows-lockdown\publish\client && dotnet publish apps\windows-lockdown\Lockedscreen.Security.Agent\Lockedscreen.Security.Agent.csproj -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained true -o apps\windows-lockdown\publish\agent
scripts.build: cmd /c npm run build:native && cmd /c npm run build:desktop
scripts.typecheck: cmd /c npm run typecheck --workspace @lockedscreen/desktop && cmd /c npm run typecheck --workspace @lockedscreen/mobile
scripts.test: cmd /c npm test --workspace @lockedscreen/parser && cmd /c npm test --workspace @lockedscreen/desktop
